title: Administration
csvImport: CSV import for the initial setup
csvHint: One line per account: name;e-mail;apartment;role (RESIDENT/ADMIN, optional);language (de/en, optional). A header line is detected. Each new account receives an invitation.
name: Name
lockConfirm: Lock the account? All sessions end immediately.
deletePreconditions: Deletion is possible when there are no open bookings (currently {open}) and no spots assigned (currently {spots}). The account is anonymised; completed bookings are kept for accounting.
deleteConfirm: Really delete? This cannot be undone.
label: Label
ownerChangeHint: On a change (e.g. sale) prices and releases are reset and the spot is paused. Existing confirmations stay with the previous owner.
deleteSpotHint: Only spots without booking history can be deleted.
planHint: Upload the plan of each level as an SVG, or the Draw.io file with all levels. In an SVG each spot area needs the plan number as its ID (or Draw.io cell ID), e.g. 501. In a Draw.io file the spots are on the layer "Parkplätze" (label = plan number), walls on the layer "Layout", pillars on the layer "Säulen"; a dashed line separates the levels and a text box names each one. Uploading a level again replaces its plan. Scripts, links and embedded content are removed.
levelNameHint: Only needed for SVG, e.g. "UG -1". Draw.io files bring their level names.
planOk: Every spot has an area and every area has a spot.
spotsWithoutArea: Spots without area in the plan
createMissingSpots: {count, plural, one {Create 1 missing spot} other {Create # missing spots}}
createMissingSpotsHint: Creates a spot without owner for every area that has none (label "Parking spot"). Assign the owners afterwards under "Spots".
levelAreas: {count, plural, one {1 spot area} other {# spot areas}}
deleteLevelConfirm: Really remove the plan of level "{level}"? The spots are kept.
templateVersion: Current version {version} from {date}. Every change creates a new version; existing contracts remain unchanged.
auditRetention: Read-only. Entries are kept for 2 years.
